name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya helps mid-market companies move AI projects from proof-of-concept to production. She has led machine learning programs across manufacturing, retail, and financial services, and focuses on the operational side of AI: data quality, governance, and measurable ROI.

name: Daniel Osei
bio: Daniel is a security practitioner with over a decade of experience defending enterprise networks. He specializes in zero-trust architecture, threat modeling, and building security programs that align with business risk rather than fear.

name: Elena Rossi
bio: Elena designs cloud platforms that balance cost, reliability, and developer velocity. She has migrated dozens of workloads to AWS and Azure and is a strong advocate for infrastructure as code and pragmatic FinOps.

name: Marcus Lee
bio: Marcus writes about the craft of building software: clean architecture, testing strategy, and delivery pipelines. He believes the best engineering decisions are the ones that keep teams shipping safely for years.
